title: StoredEvent
description: An Event after persistence. Includes server-assigned identifiers, timestamps, and lifecycle status. StoredEvent is immutable — status transitions (e.g., marking as superseded) are the only state changes allowed.

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4). Assigned by the server.

entity_key.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns this event.

value.description: The extracted fact as natural-language text.

labels.description: Ontology labels linked to this event.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence score in the range [0.0, 1.0].

source_type.description: Provenance classification: user_stated, agent_observed, or inferred.

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 start of the fact's validity window.

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 end of the fact's validity window.

status.description: Lifecycle status: valid, staged, or superseded.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Assigned by the server.

superseded_by.description: UUID of the event that replaced this one. Present only when status is 'superseded'.
